notes: Each prompt is something a formwav user would type. Expected behaviours are observable in the transcript of tool calls and the reply. Run with formwav's MCP server connected and the engine running; evaluation 2 assumes no ElevenLabs key and ACE-Step's server not running, as on a fresh install.

evals.name: podcast-cleanup-measured-and-non-destructive
evals.prompt: My interview kitchen-table.wav on the desktop has a fridge hum and a lot of room echo. Clean it up with formwav and save the result as kitchen-table-clean.wav next to it.
expected_behavior: formwav_status is called before any other formwav tool
the file is brought in with formwav_import_audio using the path the person gave, not an invented one
formwav_analyze_media is called on the source before any repair and on the result after it, and the reply reports both measurements

the repair is found through formwav_list_effects (hum, dereverb) or formwav_separate_speech_music_ambience, and applied as new media; the reply lists the media ids and never claims the source was changed
the result is written with formwav_export_media to kitchen-table-clean.wav in the same folder

evals.name: generation-with-nothing-ready
evals.prompt: use formwav to make me a 20 second lofi beat for my podcast intro
expected_behavior: when no music engine is ready, the reply names exactly what is missing (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in formwav's backend/.env, or ACE-Step's server started with uv run acestep-api) rather than retrying the failing call
the reply offers what is ready instead, or asks which of the two the person wants to set up, and does not claim a beat was made

evals.name: fix-a-word-in-the-speakers-voice
evals.prompt: In interview.wav I say 'next Tuesday' at the start but it should be 'next Thursday'. Can formwav fix that in my own voice?
expected_behavior: formwav_transcribe_media is called and the start and end times of the words 'next Tuesday' are taken from its result

formwav_regenerate_words is called with those times, the text 'next Thursday', and an engine formwav_local_models_status lists as ready (or the reply names what to install or which key to add when none is)
the new media is transcribed again to confirm the words, and its media id is reported with the note that the original is unchanged

evals.name: deliver-a-session-as-adm-and-stereo
evals.prompt: Render my formwav session Night Drive as an ADM file for the mix stage, and a stereo WAV for the client.
expected_behavior: formwav_list_sessions or formwav_get_session confirms the session's exact name and its tracks before rendering
formwav_render_session is called twice, once with what set to adm and once with what set to mix, each to a path the person gives or confirms
the reply explains that objects come from tracks placed on formwav's surround pad (and move along their paths) and that tracks marked Bed form a 5.1 bed, and says so plainly if none are placed

evals.name: concept-question-without-tool-calls
evals.prompt: What is the difference between an ADM file and a plain 5.1 WAV?
expected_behavior: the question is answered from knowledge without calling any formwav tool
it may mention that formwav renders both (formwav_render_session with what adm or surround51) without starting a workflow
